generated_replacements.text: Who may see what? Seven models answer it, each from a different angle. Qadamar combines them in one decision.
These are the models classified defence systems were built on. Qadamar brings them together in one self-hosted engine.
Every day, regulated organisations decide who may see what. Qadamar makes each of those decisions, explains it, and records it.
Qadamar. Self-hosted access control for regulated organisations.
Qadamar decides, on every request, who may see or do what. And it keeps a record of every decision.
Your access rules in one place, instead of scattered through the code. Qadamar.
